defs.def: a sweet food made from a mixture of flour, eggs, butter, sugar, etc. that is baked in an oven. Cakes are made in various shapes and sizes and are often decorated, for example with cream or icing. 糕饼；蛋糕

ex.s: Put off watching your favorite show until the weekend or wait 10 extra minutes before going for that cake.
ex.t: 把看你最喜欢的节目推迟到周末，或者在吃那块蛋糕之前多等十分钟。

ex.s: Some restaurants are happy to provide a free cake if you let them know in advance that you ________a group for a birthday party.
ex.t: 如果你提前告知餐厅你（第__空）一群人来办生日聚会，一些餐厅乐意免费提供一个蛋糕。

ex.s: Pack a bag cut a cake, guess which juice container holds the most liquid, and much more.
ex.t: 装包、切蛋糕、猜哪个果汁容器装最多液体，还有更多。

ex.s: Just quickly tun around and say, "This cake is extremely delicious and you have to tell me all about it.”
ex.t: 只要迅速转过身说：“这蛋糕太好吃了，你一定得跟我说说它的来历。”

ex.s: “Let's make a cake for Dad!” I cried.
ex.t: “我们给爸爸做个蛋糕吧！”我喊道。

ex.s: Candles on the cake!
ex.t: 蛋糕上的蜡烛！

ex.s: It fell and crashed beside the cake.
ex.t: 它掉下来在蛋糕旁摔碎了。

ex.s: She sobbed loudly as I threw the cake away.
ex.t: 当我把蛋糕扔掉时她大声哭泣。

ex.s: The birthday cake was ruined.
ex.t: 生日蛋糕毁了。

ex.s: They couldn't afford a birthday cake.
ex.t: 他们买不起生日蛋糕。

ex.s: For my fifth birthday, my mother baked me a cake ______ a monkey. （    ）
ex.t: 我五岁生日时，母亲给我烤了一个______猴子的蛋糕。（    ）

ex.s: As you can ___40___, the trip is no piece of cake.
ex.t: 为期三个月、1900英里的从巴黎到华沙之旅是杜邦谢提高欧洲及全世界对食物浪费认识的方式。

ex.s: And while some food items, such as cakes and fruit can be eaten in more or less the same way that they are on Earth, water needs to be added to much of the food that is eaten in space.
ex.t: 尽管有些食物——如蛋糕和水果——在太空中的吃法与在地球上大致相同，但太空中吃的大部分食物都需要加水。

ex.s: Commonly exchanged gifts include food such as fruit, sticky rice cakes, and homemade desserts.
ex.t: 常见的交换礼物包括水果、糯米糕和自制甜点等食物。

ex.s: It’s going to be a piece of cake!
ex.t: 那将是小菜一碟！

ex.s: It included cakes and sandwiches,andtea was It is believed that the custom began served to wash down the food.
ex.t: 它包括蛋糕和三明治，并佐以茶水下咽食物。据信这一习俗始于……

ex.s: They are making moon cakes with bean paste.
ex.t: 他们在做豆沙月饼。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: It also serves a variety of chef’s specials, beef with rice cakes, and more.
ex.t: 它还供应各种主厨特色菜、年糕炒牛肉等。

ex.s: Which restaurant can you go to for beef with rice cakes?
ex.t: 你可以去哪家餐厅吃牛肉炒年糕？

ex.s: Our __48__ in the factory were simple: Place cakes on a moving belt.
ex.t: 我们在工厂的（第48空）很简单：把蛋糕放到传送带上。

ex.s: This was __50__ than it sounds. __51__ a bit and the cakes pile up.
ex.t: 这比听起来（第50空）。（第51空）一点，蛋糕就堆起来了。

ex.s: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, family members often gather together _________ a meal, admire the moon and enjoy moon cakes.
ex.t: 中秋佳节，家人常聚在一起___一顿饭、赏月、吃月饼。

defs.def: a food mixture that is cooked in a round flat shape 饼状食物；饼
to cover sth with a thick layer of sth soft that becomes hard when it dries （厚厚一层干后即变硬的软东西）覆盖
if a substance cakes, it becomes hard when it dries （干后）结成硬块；胶凝
